top_choice_rationale: P003 pairs a quantitative theoretical prediction (the Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic angle) with a decisive experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, now reproduced by many groups across moire platforms. A citation limited to the flat bands and observed states avoids committing to a mechanism. The maturity and attribution objections (Cao and others outside the trio, open mechanism) are real, so I rank P002 and then P001 as acceptable fallbacks, with P002 ahead because it is a conceptual reclassification of electronic matter and P001 a refinement of a line recognised in 2005 and 2012. Any award is preferred to no award.
